bio: Daniel Wilentz First-Year Social Committee Crimson Yard Hi! My name is Daniel Wilentz and I am from Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Currently, I live in Pennypacker, and I am considering a concentration in History of Science. Not including FYSC I also participate in the Harvard Marching Band, where I play the snare drum, the Harvard Undergraduate Research Association, and the Harvard Undergraduate Health Policy Review. Besides that, I’m usually doing work in the Lamot or Cabot libraries or at my desk in my dorm. If I have the free time, I try to read books, talk with my friends, or just go for a walk. I am very excited to be a part of FYSC this year, and I am looking forward to all of our future events.
